verdict.rationale: Runway markets an 'agentic creative collaborator' and Characters with tool calling, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Runway acting as an MCP server that external agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) connect to. That is the opposite role. Characters' tool calling is an adjacent feature, not MCP-client support. No evidence shows users can attach MCP servers for Runway to consume.
